# Closing — Authored Cases and Honest Templates

Authored plans, not autonomous closing, real browser/API execution, stakeholder
approval, release or observation. Actual helper/service tests use disposable
projects only. Owning EPIC/FEATURE and legacy FEATURE folders both supported.

## 2. Fresh actual evidence reuse and authorized parent delta

Illustrative CR-061-01 source-flagged stale state maps to unavailable. Keep stable
IDs and no-mutation clauses; authorized intent change invalidates current/stale
selector/design/test/review/outcome evidence. Unchanged absence row is not enough
for reuse when shared selector changed; rerun all dependent checks. Unrelated dirty
docs remain protected and do not invalidate independent evidence. Do not invent
latency threshold, goals or confirmation. No CR approval is claimed by this plan.

Independently select current source/spec/code/tests/config/design/mockup/interface/
environment/evidence and original AC/types/assertions. Existing acceptance helper
may check hashes/coverage, not actual execution or semantic sufficiency. Same
relevant hashes/live environment and suitable complete actual evidence allow
reuse. If only CLI integration proven, blocked UI can't borrow those clauses.
Temporary helper consistency tests aren't feature CLI/browser acceptance. Missing
required independent review blocks meaningful risk completion; no fake reviewer.

## 3. Email/Password Login — retained original example

FEATURE-002 login example remains a plan, not 4/4 actual passes or PR #42.
Use the actual approved source/spec for all four original criteria: login with
email/password; invalid-credential error; success token; rate limiting. Retain
actual domain GWT/types and every approved clause/error branch. Do not expand
login to registration/logout merely because the old summary listed them.

- Verify real relevant API request/status/body/token/error/rate-limit evidence,
  plus actual isolated browser interaction/console if required by source/UI mockup.
- Goal: only the source's explicit story so-that (labeled inferred for legacy)
  may supply stakeholder intent; this example does not invent an authentication
  success metric or stakeholder approval. Delivery and outcome gap separate.
- Review relevant code/spec/both design parts/tests for risk and misleading docs;
  rate-limit behavior already approved but omitted from explanation may be
  documented. An unapproved new edge criterion requires approved CR, not inline
  specification change to match faulty code.
- Correct README/API docs only where misleading, rehash/rerun affected evidence.
  No compulsory refactoring analysis, invented eight-file scope or 8/10 score.
  An existing actual assessment may recommend token extraction, but optional
  means is not a backlog mandate or permission to refactor during closing.
- Engineering-only: no commit/push/PR by default. Explicit scoped release with
  authority may instantiate the original PR template and real testing facts;
  missing release permission blocks required release, not fabricated PR #42.
- Original task_completion_output/next refinement suggestion retained. No User
  Manual successor, feature_status alias, require_human_review field or fake
  Done Feature Closing board status. Owner marks Completed/task completed once
  only after actual domain/app/category gates; unobserved outcome explicit.

## 4. Verification Template — retained and extended

Use [closing report scaffold](.github/skills/x-ipe-task-based-feature-closing/templates/closing-report.md)
for complete source/goal/AC/actual evidence mapping. Legacy compact verification
also remains available, but cannot replace original clause/type/revision coverage:

```markdown
## Acceptance Criteria Verification

| # | Criterion | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| {stable AC} | {every approved Given/When/Then clause} | {Met/Not Met/Blocked} | {actual suitable command/result/environment/revision or gap} |
| {UI AC if applicable} | {original scoped mockup/assertions} | {actual status} | {actual browser path/console/current artifact, never source-only} |
```

A table is not an execution engine. Only complete suitable current actual evidence
supports verified engineering delivery. Preserve planned/failure/history rows.

## 5. Completion Summary Template — retained and corrected

```markdown
## Feature Closing: {actual feature}

### Delivered / Acceptance
{actual capabilities and complete scoped original evidence, or blockers}
### Files Changed
{only actual owned paths/delta; counts diagnostic, not benefit}
### Goal / Subgoal / Outcome Gaps
{source/parent/AC links, source scenario, not measured or actual observation citation}
### Review / Docs
{actual risk review and misleading corrections or no-change rationale}
### Release / Pull Request
{not requested/performed, or actual authorized release/PR evidence; no fictional link}
### Refactoring Assessment
{current real assessment or not assessed, N/A/no evidenced recommendation/[]}
### Workflow / Owner Boundary
{actual feature_closing state/readback, {} output mapping, report task link, prior gates or blockers}
```

Unassessed quality output is compatible, not proof quality acceptable. Existing
[PR](.github/skills/x-ipe-task-based-feature-closing/references/templates/pr-template.md)
and [changelog](.github/skills/x-ipe-task-based-feature-closing/references/templates/changelog-template.md)
templates preserved unchanged. Mark legacy playground checkbox N/A absent explicit
request; no auto playground, invented screenshots/test checks or new release work.

## 6. Human Communication Template — retained and mode-aware

```text
{Feature} engineering delivery: {verified at current revision or blocked}.
Acceptance/review evidence: {actual linked artifacts and limits}.
Stakeholder outcome: {not measured + source scenario/gap, or actual observation citation}.
Release/PR: {not performed/not requested, or actual authorized evidence/blocker}.
Next: {actual current owner boundary and conditional approved backlog suggestion}.
```

Human asks human at actual within-skill decisions and waits; full DAO and hybrid
use bounded guidance. One owner requires human completion/route confirmation for
human and hybrid, or full DAO authorized routing; explicit human approval/release still
required when domain asks it. Summary delivery is not stakeholder acknowledgment.

## 7. Actual template/runtime empty output and optional CR context

Current feature_closing has deliverables [], specification required and optional
refactor-report. Owner uses deliverables {}, keeps closing report task artifact,
checks actual feature/status/context/readback once. No closing-report extract tag.
Actual CLI and runtime service reject the bogus tag even for a real report path.
Empty mapping is valid, not fabricated missing evidence waiver. Required domain
acceptance and prior code_refactor gate remain independently enforced; temporary
permissive writer success with pending refactor is not semantic closure.

change_request optional closing-report may be absent; required specification
still actual. Explicit verified task artifact can be handed off, no automatic app
extraction/discovery claimed. Free-mode app untouched. Completed resume read-only;
Implemented or Tested need real full evidence, no contradictory status/commit gate.
